identification: Box of Tasmanian paper ephemera plus two small objects. Items readable: (1) a long handwritten 'Abstract of the Title' of land (a solicitor's copy reciting earlier deeds, entries for 1841/1842 and '23 January 18__ Original deposited in the office of the Registrar of Deeds at Hobart Town, Book .. No ..'), parties incl. John Kemp(?) and a widow; it is an abstract (later copy), not an original 1841 deed. (2) A folded Mortgage with the Tasmanian Permanent Executors and Trustees Association, dated 19x9 (looks 1919 or 1929). (3) 'Subdivision Sale Westwood Estate' booklet, for the Tasmanian Woolgrowers Agency Company Limited, Launceston. (4) 'Handbook of Tasmanian Emergency Legislation' (WWII-era, government printer). (5) Blue booklet 'Directions for the erection of domestic surface shelters' (WWII air-raid shelters). (6) Tasmanian Football Record, 1960s (Heathorns Morris 1100 advert on cover). (7) Greyhound racing programme (Tasmanian club, 1960s). (8) 1917 cover 'Tasmania' postmark 14 SEP 17 addressed to Woodlands(?), Ringarooma, Tasmania, KGV red stamp; another cover/card. (9) Real-photo prints: a locomotive in a tunnel/shed, an oval landscape photo, newspaper cuttings ('Orange Blossom' wedding). (10) Small bag of loose stamps (common KGV reds etc) and a student ticket. (11) Two railway dog spikes tied with a handwritten tag 'Clyde dog spikes type used at Tasmania mining sites on light rail lines'. (12) A small cast zinc slab stamped 'Electrolytic Zinc Australasia' with lightning-bolt logo, three panels (EZ Co, Risdon souvenir ingot/sample, with a brass peg).
